verdict.rationale: AWS IAM's own docs show permissions are expressed as JSON policy documents across nine policy types, including identity-based, resource-based, VPC endpoint policies and permissions boundaries. These policies attach to users, groups, roles or the resources themselves to control which resources an identity can reach, which is the core of expressible least privilege. Missing for 10: no evidence of IAM condition keys or condition blocks, no documentation of policy evaluation logic (how allow/deny combine across policy types), and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
